capabilities: play local files, remote URLs, and YouTube/Vimeo videos in Obsidian
insert clickable timestamp links that jump to exact media moments
capture video screenshots and embed them with timestamp links
link .srt and .vtt transcripts to media for navigation and quoted timestamps
control playback with global hotkeys and pinned players
extras: License change: v4 releases are closed source; the open-source v3 codebase remains on the v3 branch. Detailed guides live in external documentation, not the README. The plugin discloses that it may access files outside the vault and make network connections for streaming and WebDAV.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play video or audio inside notes and link notes to specific moments in the media.

relations.evidence: videos from services like YouTube and Vimeo directly in Obsidian
play local media files, remote URLs, and videos from services like YouTube and Vimeo

summary: Media player integration that plays local and online video and audio in notes, with clickable timestamps, screenshots, and transcript navigation.
